question: How does an HTTP/2 stream end?

sources.rank_basis: originator: the about page shows she edited the spec section

facts.summary: Setting END_STREAM moves an open stream to a half-closed state.
facts.quote: Either peer may set the END_STREAM flag on a frame, and the stream then moves to one of the two half-closed states

facts.summary: RST_STREAM ends a stream at once.
facts.quote: A peer sends RST_STREAM to end a stream at once

facts.summary: A server stopping early resets the stream without waiting.
facts.quote: A server that wants to stop early sends RST_STREAM and does not wait for the client

facts.summary: A safe method asks for no change on the server.
facts.quote: A method is safe when the client does not ask for any change on the server

conflicts.note: the spec says either peer; the blog speaks of servers only
